+// Lints every Markdown file in the repository — prose docs and grammars —
+// under the shared `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc`.
+//
+// markdownlint-cli2 is resolved from this package's node_modules (module
+// resolution is relative to this file), while linting runs from the repo
+// root so the `**/*.md` glob and the `**/node_modules/**` ignore both
+// behave. This complements `gramaire check`, which lints the structure/drift
+// gates of a single grammar file; here we also cover README, docs/, and
+// every other Markdown file in the tree.
+//
+// Deliberately kept Node-native and standalone (not ported to Scala/JVM):
+// it lints repo-wide Markdown, has no compiler-core relationship, and no
+// mature JVM equivalent exists.
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { main as markdownlint } from "markdownlint-cli2";
+
+process.chdir(fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url)));
+process.exit(await markdownlint({ argv: ["**/*.md"] }));
